Today’s injury wire is mostly IR churn, one season-ending injury, and a few return-to-practice notes.

**Roster / IR moves**
- **Bears CB Jaylon Jones** was released from IR after an injury settlement. He had a **hamstring injury** in the preseason finale.
- **Saints CB Dalys Beanum** and **OT Barry Wesley** reached injury settlements and will be released from IR. Both had been placed on IR on cutdown day.
- **Raiders rookie DE Keyron Crawford** will **miss the season** with an **Achilles injury**.

**Availability updates**
- **Browns Isaiah Bond** remains in **concussion protocol**. He has the long weekend to try to clear for **Jaguars week**.
- **CB Tyson Campbell** was **watching from the sideline**.
- **Mike Hall Jr.** is **back practicing**.
- Also back practicing: **RG Teven Jenkins** and **DE Jared Verse**.
- **Texans TE Brevin Jordan** is **very close** and is expected to **practice next week**.

**Why it matters**
- Crawford’s injury is a depth hit for Las Vegas before the season even starts.
- Bond’s concussion status is the main game-week question.
- Hall Jr.’s return to practice is the clearest positive sign today; Brevin Jordan is the next return watch.
